classificationNotes.localDisruption: Destination uplift displaced if origin has the extra supply/headroom. This does not infer flight continuation.
classificationNotes.sharedQuota: For the same q delivered, tankering consumes q/a rather than q units from a shared regional fuel quota; the difference is burned. This resource identity is not a cancellation model and does not rule out benefits from reallocating scarce fuel geographically.
classificationNotes.uncertainty: Finite sensitivity envelopes, not probabilistic confidence intervals or forecasts.

counterfactual.comparison: Buy q at destination versus carry enough extra origin fuel to deliver the same q at destination.
notEstablished: actual airport prices or available stocks
counterfactual.quantityBasis: One tonne useful fuel delivered at destination; local-interruption headroom is separately one tonne loaded at origin.

sensitivitySummary.interpretation: Exhaustive finite factorial grid, not a probability distribution.
